text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day after school. Faced with a 
mountain of paperwork,
I couldn't help but 
slump over my desk.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Oh…… That face. Your battery is 
completely drained, isn't it?"
choice_data_list: Sorry, I'm kinda swamped right now...
Sorry, things are a bit hectic rig...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"At times like this, the priority is to 
get yourself in order. Time to recharge!"
choice_data_list: I'm a bit tied up, you see...
I'm a little tied up right now...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Want to try doing my fatigue recovery 
routine together?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
First, to get into shape physically and 
mentally,
I was taken to a dance studio by 
Daring Heart.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
When the body is in disarray, the mind 
wavers too. And vice versa.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
That's why at the end of every day, I 
always align my breathing and posture.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: For instance, like this— Copy my pose.
choice_data_list: Um... and... hup...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu,
as long as it's within your range of 
movement, that's fine. Find what feels 
"just right" for you.
choice_data_list: Um... and hup...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
And take a long, hard look. —At who you 
truly are.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daring Heart lectures in a calm, steady 
voice. Feeling reassured by her tone, my 
body gradually begins to relax.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Now then. Close your eyes this time. 
Breathe in slowly... and out...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
――Imagine... We are deep inside a lush 
forest.
You can hear the cheerful songs of 
little birds.
choice_data_list: (Forest... little birds...)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
The wind gently strokes your cheek. 
Sunlight filters through the trees—
choice_data_list: (Forest... little birds...)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: See? You can feel it, can't you?
choice_data_list: ...Ah, we're in the forest.
...Yeah, we're in the forest.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Now, take a deeper breath. Focus your 
awareness on my words.
choice_data_list: ...Yeah, deep in the woods.
...Yeah, we really are in the woods.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Now, breathe in............ And breathe 
out............

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I focused on Daring Heart's voice and
took 
a deep breath. Her voice resonated 
comfortably, and...
choice_data_list: (My body feels lighter...)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Heheh. Looking good. Your color's 
finally back.
choice_data_list: (My body feels... so light...)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Now that body and mind are in peak 
condition, this is our chance. I'll begin 
putting on the finishing touches.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—Thanks for waiting! Here's my special 
banana and Japanese mustard spinach 
smoothie.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I added some honey as a little bonus 
today. Here you go.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The moment I tasted the smoothie I was 
handed, a refreshing sweetness spread 
throughout my entire body—
choice_data_list:
It feels like my whole body is 
re...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, naturally. A drink after tuning 
yourself up hits different, doesn't it?
choice_data_list: It feels like my whole body is rej...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Joy for the heart, nourishment for the 
body. That's my personal rule♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...The nutrients smoothly absorb into my 
conditioned body.
It's as if my exhaustion 
from earlier was just an illusion."
choice_data_list: —Thanks for today, Heart.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Fufu! No need to thank me!
choice_data_list: ――Thanks for today, Heart.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:

queen walking around looking like a 
zombie, after all."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I want you to show me your 
reliable side.

text_block_list.text:
You are my precious buddy. No one else 
could ever take your place.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "So please, take better care of yourself."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Sounds good!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
For example, watching candle flames or 
practicing mindfulness can leave you 
feeling refreshed.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I'll teach you some other routines I 
recommend. Follow me!
